audio.text: Do you think the library will still have a copy?

options: It's worth checking the online catalog.
I copied my notes from Jake.
Yes, I still live right near the main library.

why.en: Indirect: suggests how to find out. B reuses "copy" with another meaning.
why.tr: Dolaylı: nasıl öğrenileceğini öneriyor. B "copy" kelimesini başka anlamda kullanıyor.
why.es: Indirecta: sugiere cómo averiguarlo. B reutiliza "copy" con otro significado.
